name: Final Day: José Almeida Pereira
description: This Saturday is your last chance to see 'Ações à distância, leves como os teus raios,' a compelling solo exhibition by the Portuguese artist.
longDescription:
This Saturday marks the closing day for 'Ações à distância, leves como os teus raios,' a solo exhibition by Portuguese artist José Almeida Pereira at Kubik Gallery. The exhibition features a collection of works exploring themes of distance and light, presented through Pereira's distinctive artistic approach. His practice often engages with the ephemeral and the subtle, inviting contemplation on perception and presence.

Visitors to Kubik Gallery on the final day can expect to engage with the exhibition at their own pace. The gallery space provides an intimate setting for viewing the artworks. The event is open to all members of the public interested in contemporary art.

Admission to the exhibition is free. Kubik Gallery is located in Porto, a short walk from Trindade metro station. The event begins at 19:00.
